title: Q2 Playbook: Prioritization Matrix for Hosted Endpoints, Model Rotation Triggers, and SLA Messaging
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a repeatable quarterly playbook that (1) defines a prioritization matrix for Hosted API endpoints and model variants, (2) codifies model rotation triggers (health, quality, cost), and (3) defines customer-facing SLA messaging and internal rollout runbooks. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design to land the artifacts, wire up basic automation for rotation triggers in the Console, and produce a one-page customer-facing FAQ for upcoming model rotations and expected behavior during capacity/fallback events.
acceptance_criteria: Publish a prioritization matrix spreadsheet that ranks endpoints by customer impact, throughput sensitivity, and regression risk
Document model rotation triggers with concrete thresholds (latency P95, token-cost delta, eval drift) and owner assignments
Create a Console-to-Runbook mapping: each prioritized endpoint has an associated rollout playbook (canary, rollback, fallback model) in Confluence
Wire a minimal alerting webhook from Console that emits rotation-trigger events to the Ops team (integration smoke test passes)
Produce and review customer-facing SLA messaging and FAQ; legal/comms sign-off obtained
decisions: Adopt three-tier trigger model: Quality (eval drift > 8%), Cost (per-token > 15% above baseline), and Reliability (P95 latency > 2x SLO) — triggers are sufficient for automated canary or manual review depending on tier
Prioritization scoring will weight customer impact x2, SLO sensitivity x1.5, and regression risk x1 — simple score out of 100
Initial rollout will target top 12 endpoints representing ~65% of hosted traffic before expanding to lower tiers
tradeoffs: Automating rotations quickly reduces operator load but risks noisy rollouts; chosen mitigation is a hybrid: automated detection + manual approval for tier-1 endpoints
Strict cost-based rotations could oscillate models for volatile workloads; we limit cost-trigger frequency to once per 24h per endpoint
Investing in full Console automation now delays polish on customer messaging; we prioritize a minimal, transparent FAQ to ship earlier
